The chat `85f80150-…` (title *"Agent project list interruption error debug"*) contains a fenced code block in the assistant's reply. streamdown renders code blocks with a lazily-imported Shiki highlighter:

In dev, Vite serves that chunk from its on-the-fly optimized-deps cache (`node_modules/.vite/deps/…?v=<hash>`). - A `vite:preloadError` listener in `main.tsx` catches the same failure for preloaded route chunks.
- The guard flag auto-clears after 5s of healthy runtime, so a genuinely new re-optimization later can still self-heal without risking a reload loop.
